blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Maps Navigation (visionOS 26 Maps / Apple Glass): Monocular 600x600 variant of visionOS Maps. True live passthrough world behind, not painted gradient — saturate1.6 blur28 heavy glass with rim light. No chrome until needed. Map is minimal: thin 22r translucent wash (rgba18,26,38 0.62 blur28) over world, streets as 0.04-0.06 hairlines, route as single 11px accent line with soft 22px glow and 2px dashed center, no 4 competing pin pills — only destination pin + pulsing you-dot (8px accent 6px halo, single 1.6s pulse that stops after 3 cycles). Header hides after 1s: shows one pill Center · ETA · distance 11/700 tabular with 6px ok dot, not two equal pills. Hero is single turn-card: 64r? Actually 22r mat-raised, 72px arrow-box gradient accent 64→64, 34px glyph 2.4 stroke, distance 32/800 -0.04 tabular + street 15/700 -0.01 + single Next action 11/600, no lane hint until 80m before turn then 3 lanes 18x10 appear with 0.28 outline only on target lane, dir-badge hidden until gaze. Controls are hidden strip 14r mat-glass that reveals on gaze near: single Reroute ghost pill + Mute ghost, no visible toll toggle until overflow menu. Upcoming is one peeking chip 36h current only, others clipped with 0.42 opacity and blur falloff, single hint Gaze+dwell 10 0.06em dimmed. Motion strictly 220-280ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible spring, rise-in 260ms once, you-dot 320ms glide interruptible by look-away reverse 180ms, no infinite shimmer. Typography 3 sizes: 32 hero / 14 street / 11 meta tabular only. Edge states as native sheets over passthrough with one 64 illustration + single CTA + caption. Glance <0.9s: distance → arrow → done. One focal bloom always: turn-card at rest.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Navigation (Quest 3 Horizon Home Maps v74): Flat opaque panel #121418 12r, 1px #2a2a2a border, shadow 8px, no backdrop-filter. Stage is solid dark #0e182c no radial wash, no blur glass, no sheen. Map header 44h opaque bar Navigation 16/700 left + battery right, two pills flat grey 28r 11/600 no blur (route φ + ETA). Street grid repeating linear 0.07 grey lines. Route is flat blue 10px #56b8ff no glow, dashed white 2px opaque. Pins are flat grey 11/600 chips with no backdrop: You·Valencia, Next·ValenciaSt blue flat no wash, MarketSt, FerryBuilding all equal weight overlapping route. You-dot flat white 14px no pulse. Progress is flat grey track 8h #2a2a2a fill #56b8ff linear, no sheen. Turn-card flat #2a2a2a 12r with 48px arrow box flat blue, distance 28/700 30? actually 26/700 non-tabular, street 13/500, action Then Take ramp 12/400, lanes flat grey 22x14 with thin 1px stroke, dir-badge flat blue #56b8ff on grey. Controls flat equal weight: Reroute flat blue circle 36 + Mute flat grey circle 36 + Avoid tolls toggle flat grey switch 52x32 2px knob no animation, hint row cramped 10/600 3 phrases. Upcoming is 4 flat grey chips 28r 11/600 equal weight, current only 1px blue border, not dimmed. Motion linear 400ms slide + 20px overshoot bounce, word reveal instant, you-dot jumps. Typography 11/13/14 flat, no tabular beyond time, 4 sizes same chip. Edge states: empty centered text No route yet 16/600 no illustration, loading spinner + Loading 14/500, error red text Something wrong flat retry grey, offline snackbar Offline queuing overlapping list, permission system opaque dialog. No reduced-motion, no dwell halo. Glance ~2.8s no hero.
